boundaries:
1. Herc Rentals Inc. (Nov 2024 – Present): AWS Lakehouse (S3, Kinesis, EMR), Databricks Streaming, Delta Lake, PySpark, Teradata, SQL data serving.
2. Blue Yonder (08/2021 – 03/2023): Microsoft Azure (ADLS Gen2, Databricks), Python (FastAPI, Requests, SQLAlchemy), Snowflake, Exasol, Terraform, Docker.
3. Accenture (06/2018 – 07/2021): AWS + Spark Core/SQL tuning, Apache Airflow, Amazon Redshift, Docker, Jenkins, CI/CD, Financial Regulatory Compliance.
4. Thomson Reuters (07/2016 – 05/2018): Big Data / Hadoop Migration, AWS EMR, Glue, Sqoop, HiveQL, Athena, Redshift, MS SQL Server, Parquet, HiveQL.
bridging_rules:
- If BI/Dashboards (Tableau, Power BI, Qlik, SSRS) are NOT explicitly demanded in the target JD: STRICTLY SUPPRESS dashboard bullets and analyst vocabulary. Focus all Phase 4/5 bullets on SQL performance, partition pruning, materialized views, and analytical table optimization.
- If Kafka is requested: Map to Kinesis / Databricks streaming pipelines and event-streaming paradigms.
- If Snowflake / BigQuery is requested: Emphasize cloud warehousing patterns (clustering, star schemas, query profiling, partition pruning).
- If 3rd-party APIs are requested: Emphasize the metadata-driven REST API ingestion framework built in Python (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy) at Blue Yonder.
- If Data Governance / Catalogs (Atlan, Collibra) are requested: Map to AWS Glue Data Catalog and metadata-driven access control policies.

skills_schema.cloud: <Cloud platforms emphasizing those in the JD (AWS, Azure, GCP)>
skills_schema.bigdata: <Distributed processing frameworks (Spark, PySpark, Databricks, Delta Lake, Kafka/Kinesis)>
skills_schema.databases: <Databases, warehouses & storage formats (Redshift, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, Teradata, Parquet)>
skills_schema.devops: <Orchestration & deployment (Airflow, Docker, Jenkins, Git, Terraform, CI/CD)>
skills_schema.modeling_tuning: <Data modeling, query tuning & architectural concepts (Star Schema, SCD Type 2, CDC, AQE, Broadcast Joins)>
